theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), Q.val = ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) r.val + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (n - r.val)) Q.val • MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) r.val + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (n - r.val)) (1 : ℂ)
theorems.natural_summary: Compare coefficients. Homogeneity makes coefficients outside degree n vanish on both sides. Every degree-n exponent is uniquely determined by r = d(0), with d(1) = n − r, so the sum has exactly one potentially nonzero matching term. Coefficient extensionality concludes the equality, including n = 0.
